_README: IRON RULE 2b RATCHET LIST — generated once on 2026-07-24, then only ever SHRINKS.

Each entry is a talent whose NAME appears as a string literal in engine CODE (register-skills.js, comments excluded). That is the rule-2b smell: behaviour bound to a string rather than to the talent document, so the talent ships with empty Events/Effects tabs, editing them in Foundry does nothing, and renaming the talent silently unwires it.
- a talent name in the engine that is NOT listed here  -> ERROR (the list may not grow)
- a name listed here that is NO LONGER in the engine   -> ERROR (delete the line; the list must not become fiction)

To migrate a talent: move its behaviour onto the talent as system.events / effects in data/authored/<atlas>-<tree>.json, delete the name-keyed branch from the engine, then delete its line here. To take a declared exit instead (ENGINE-OWNED / MANUAL, see CLAUDE.md iron rule 2b) the talent still leaves this list — an exit is a declaration, not a name-keyed branch.
DO NOT regenerate this file to make the gate pass. Adding an entry is the violation the gate exists to catch. See EDHA_EDITABILITY_AUDIT.md for the migration plan.
